gen-almendra-display-gf-alumni-sans: Almendra Display has an ornate, bookish look, its letters never pinching shut. Alumni Sans follows with a gentle thick-thin shift that is noticeable but never dramatic, a good foil for the heading's showy curves.
gen-almendra-display-gf-alumni-sans-pins: Ornate and literary up top, with a tall x-height. Alumni Sans Pinstripe sits below in tight, marker-traced strokes, and the gap between that plain sans and Almendra Display's flourish is the pair's whole appeal.
gen-almendra-display-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Almendra Display's letters never seem to pinch shut, which gives the heading a storybook generosity. And Alumni Sans SC, with oversized lowercase and squeezed spacing, would read dense and compact, its stems just a touch heavier than the hairlines.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anaheim: Literary and ornate, Almendra Display makes the first move with its tall x-height. But Anaheim packs its rounded, open forms into a dense huddle, so a long stretch of text slides past the eye in one smooth run.
gen-almendra-display-gf-arsenal: Storybook flourish, then straight talk. Arsenal has an x-height close to its cap height and a modest dip-pen shift in each stroke, and it holds up well when you keep its size moderate; Almendra Display handles the drama above.
gen-almendra-display-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC sits tight and clean, with a faint thick-thin shift and wide-mouthed curves. Beneath Almendra Display, a long page of it would read compact and quietly crisp.
gen-almendra-display-gf-asimovian: Ornate against stripped-back. Asimovian builds tall lowercase from a single unbroken line weight, and Almendra Display would lose its footing if it were shrunk small beside that, so give the heading room.
gen-almendra-display-gf-basic: Almendra Display's letters never seem to pinch shut, and that openness is what you notice first. But Basic keeps a gentle bump from small letters to capitals, so a long passage moves along with a tidy, clean rhythm.
gen-almendra-display-gf-cal-sans: Cal Sans runs one stroke width through the whole alphabet, with short ascenders and a tall x-height, smooth as plotter lines. And Almendra Display, ornate and literary, earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-almendra-display-gf-carlito: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, with a pronounced x-height and letters that stay open. Carlito answers it with tight spacing and round shapes that read clearly even small, a modern plain sans that holds the pair together.
